skillset.skill: 40s CT - 6000% Water DMG (Physical). If own HP is 70% or above, increase own Physical DMG by 50% for 10s. If own HP is below 70%, heal 30% of MAX HP instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Touma Kamijo, increase own DMG resistance by 30% and Arts by 1/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
